You will hear Mia and Dad planning an outdoor day.
Dad: Are we going to camp on Saturday?
Mia: The nights may be cold. Let’s just have a picnic on Sunday.
Dad: All right. Where shall we go?
Mia: The lake is quite far away. Let’s go to the park.
Dad: Will we leave at nine?
Mia: Can we leave at ten instead? I need to finish my homework first.
Dad: Yes. What are you bringing?
Mia: I am going to bring water. You can carry the food.
Dad: Fine. If it rains, we can eat in the visitor centre.
Mia: Good. We will not need to go home straight away.
